الدليل الكامل لاجتياز امتحان الباكالوريا في اللغة الإنجليزية بالدارجة
By Abdelhamid Haji

Complete BAC English Guide — Grammar, Vocabulary, Functions, Writing, National Exams & More

1. Grammar (القواعد)

1.1 Present Simple (المضارع البسيط)

الاستعمال: كيخدم على:
1) العادات والروتين — She goes to school every day. (هي كتمشي لكل مدرسة كل نهار)
2) الحقائق العلمية — Water boils at 100°C. (الماء كيغلي عند 100 درجة)
3) الحقائق العامة — The sun rises in the east. (الشمس كتطلع من الشرق)
التركيب (Form):
الإثبات (Affirmative): Subject + V1 (s/es مع he/she/it)
النفي (Negative): Subject + do/does + not + V1
الاستفهام (Question): Do/Does + Subject + V1?
أمثلة:
I play football every Friday. — أنا كنلعب الكورة كل جمعة
She studies hard for the BAC. — هي كتقرا بزاف للباك
They don't eat meat. — هم ماكياكلوش اللحم
Does he speak English? — واش هو كيهدر بالنجليزية؟
علامات (Signal words): always, usually, often, sometimes, never, every day/week, generally, rarely, seldom
Exercise: Complete with the Present Simple.
1. She _______ (go) to school every day.
2. They _______ (not / like) coffee.
3. _______ he _______ (speak) English?
4. Water _______ (boil) at 100°C.
Answers: 1. goes, 2. don't like, 3. Does...speak, 4. boils

1.2 Present Continuous (المضارع المستمر)

الاستعمال:
1) شيء كيوقع دابا فهاد اللحظة — I am studying now. (أنا كيقرا دابا)
2) خطط مستقبلية — I am visiting Marrakech next week. (أنا غادي نزور مراكش السيمانة الجاية)
3) موقتة (temporary situations) — He is staying with his uncle. (هو كيبقات عند عمه)
التركيب: Subject + am/is/are + V-ing
النفي: Subject + am/is/are + not + V-ing
الاستفهام: Am/Is/Are + Subject + V-ing?
I am reading a book. — أنا كينقرا كتاب
She is cooking dinner. — هي كطياب العشا
They are playing football. — هم كيلعبو الكورة
He is not sleeping. — هو مانيش نايس
Are you listening? — واش انت كتسمع؟
علامات: now, at the moment, currently, today, this week, tonight, Look! Listen!
Exercise: Put the verbs in Present Continuous.
1. Listen! Someone _______ (sing).
2. I _______ (study) for my exam this week.
3. They _______ (not / play) football right now.
4. _______ she _______ (cook) dinner?
Answers: 1. is singing, 2. am studying, 3. are not playing, 4. Is...cooking

1.3 Present Perfect (المضارع التام)

الاستعمال:
1) تجارب حياتية — I have visited Paris. (زرت پاري — المهم هي التجربة، ماشي الوقت)
2) شيء بدا فالماضي ولسع كاين دابا — I have lived here for 5 years. (ساكن هنا من 5 سنين)
3) شيء تما قريبا وعندو تأثير على الحاضر — I have lost my keys. (ضيعت مفاتحي ولّا كندور عليهم دابا)
التركيب: Subject + have/has + V3 (past participle)
النفي: Subject + have/has + not + V3
الاستفهام: Have/Has + Subject + V3?
She has visited Paris twice. — هي زارت پاري جوج مرات
I have finished my homework. — كمّلت الخدمة ديالي
They have never been to London. — هم عمري ما مشاو للندن
Have you ever eaten sushi? — واش عمري كلتي سوشي؟
علامات: already, just, yet, ever, never, since, for, recently, lately, so far
Exercise: Complete with Present Perfect.
1. I _______ (never / eat) sushi.
2. She _______ (already / finish) her homework.
3. _______ he _______ (visit) Paris?
4. They _______ (live) here since 2010.
Answers: 1. have never eaten, 2. has already finished, 3. Has...visited, 4. have lived

1.4 Present Perfect Continuous (المضارع التام المستمر)

الاستعمال: شيء بدا فالماضي ولسع مستمر تا دابا وكتأكد على المدة ديالو
I have been studying for three hours. — أنا كيقرا من تلت ساعات (ومازلت كيقرا)
التركيب: Subject + have/has + been + V-ing
النفي: Subject + have/has + not + been + V-ing
She has been waiting for 30 minutes. — هي كتسنا من 30 دقيقة
They have been working all day. — هم كيخدمو النهار كامل
I have been feeling tired lately. — أنا حاس براسي تعبان هاد الأيام
الفرق بين Present Perfect و Present Perfect Continuous:
I have read the book. (قرات الكتاب — كمّلته)
I have been reading the book. (كنقرا الكتاب — مازلت مكمّلتهاش)
Exercise: Present Perfect or Continuous?
1. I _______ (read) three books this week. (emphasis on completion)
2. She _______ (wait) for an hour. (emphasis on duration)
3. They _______ (travel) to many countries.
4. He _______ (work) here since 8 AM.
Answers: 1. have read, 2. has been waiting, 3. have travelled, 4. has been working

1.5 Past Simple (الماضي البسيط)

الاستعمال: حوايج تماو و كملو فالماضي
She visited Marrakech last year. — هي زارت مراكش العام اللي فات
التركيب: Subject + V2 (regular -ed / irregular)
النفي: Subject + did + not + V1
الاستفهام: Did + Subject + V1?
He went to Casablanca yesterday. — هو مشى للدار البيضا أمس
They played football last Friday. — هم لعبو الكورة الجمعة اللي فاتت
I did not see the movie. — أنا ما شفتش الفيلم
Did she call you? — واش هي عطلات عليك؟
علامات: yesterday, last night/week/month, ago, in 1999, when I was young
Exercise: Put in Past Simple.
1. She _______ (go) to the cinema last night.
2. I _______ (not / see) the movie.
3. _______ they _______ (arrive) on time?
4. He _______ (buy) a new phone yesterday.
Answers: 1. went, 2. did not see, 3. Did...arrive, 4. bought

1.6 Past Continuous (الماضي المستمر)

الاستعمال:
1) شيء كان مستمر فالماضي وجاه شي حاجة قطعتو — I was reading when the phone rang.
2) جوج حوايج كانو كيدوزو ف نفس الوقت — While I was cooking, she was watching TV.
التركيب: Subject + was/were + V-ing
النفي: Subject + was/were + not + V-ing
I was studying when the power went out. — كنت كيقرا ملا قطع الضو
They were playing at 8 PM yesterday. — هم كانو كيلعبو فالساعة 8 دأمس
She was not sleeping when I arrived. — هي ما كانتش نايسة ملا جيت
علامات: while, when, as, at 8 PM yesterday, all day yesterday
Exercise: Past Simple or Continuous?
1. I _______ (read) when the phone _______ (ring).
2. She _______ (cook) while he _______ (watch) TV.
3. They _______ (play) football at 5 PM yesterday.
4. He _______ (sleep) when the alarm _______ (go) off.
Answers: 1. was reading / rang, 2. was cooking / was watching, 3. were playing, 4. was sleeping / went

1.7 Past Perfect (الماضي التام)

الاستعمال: شيء تما قبل شيء آخر فالماضي
When I arrived, they had already left. — ملا وصلت، هم كانو مشاو قبل
التركيب: Subject + had + V3
النفي: Subject + had + not + V3
She had finished her homework before dinner. — هي كانت كمّلت الخدمة قبل العشا
I had never seen such a beautiful place. — عمري ما شفت بلاصة بحال هادي
They had already left when we arrived. — هم كانو مشاو ملا وصلنا
علامات: after, before, by the time, already, just, never, when
Exercise: Complete with Past Perfect.
1. When I arrived, they _______ (already / leave).
2. She _______ (finish) her work before dinner.
3. I _______ (never / see) such a beautiful sunset.
4. He _______ (not / eat) anything before the party.
Answers: 1. had already left, 2. had finished, 3. had never seen, 4. had not eaten

1.8 Past Perfect Continuous (الماضي التام المستمر)

الاستعمال: شيء كان مستمر مدة معينة قبل شيء آخر فالماضي
They had been waiting for two hours when the bus arrived. (هم كانو كيسناو ساعتين ملا جات الطوبيسة)
التركيب: Subject + had + been + V-ing
She had been studying for hours before the exam. — هي كانت كتقرا لساعات قبل الامتحان
I had been working there for five years before I quit. — كنت كيخدم تما لخمس سنين قبل ما نخرج

1.9 Future Simple (المستقبل البسيط)

الاستعمال:
1) predictions — It will rain tomorrow. (غادي تمطر غدا)
2) promises — I will help you. (غادي نعاونك)
3) spontaneous decisions — I will answer the phone. (أنا غادي نجاوب)
التركيب: Subject + will + V1
النفي: Subject + will + not (won't) + V1
I will call you later. — غادي نعطل عليك من بعد
She won't come to the party. — هي ما غادي تجيش للحفلة
Will they arrive on time? — واش غادي يوصلو ف الوقت؟
علامات: tomorrow, next week/month, soon, in the future, later, tonight

1.10 Future Continuous (المستقبل المستمر)

الاستعمال: شيء غادي يكون مستمر ف وقت معين فالمستقبل
This time next week, I will be flying to London. (هاد الوقت السيمانة الجاية، غادي نكون طاير للندن)
التركيب: Subject + will + be + V-ing
I will be studying at 8 PM tonight. — غادي نكون كيقرا فالساعة 8 الليلة
She will be working when we arrive. — هي غادي تكون كتخدم ملا نوصلو

1.11 Future Perfect (المستقبل التام)

الاستعمال: شيء غادي يكون كمل قبل وقت معين فالمستقبل
By 2025, I will have graduated. (على حساب 2025، غادي نكون تخرجت)
التركيب: Subject + will + have + V3
She will have finished the project by Friday. — هي غادي تكون كملت المشروع لجمع
They will have arrived before midnight. — هم غادي يكونو وصلو قبل منتصف الليل
علامات: by, by the time, before, by then, by next week

1.12 Future Perfect Continuous (المستقبل التام المستمر)

الاستعمال: شيء غادي يكون مستمر لمدة معينة قبل وقت محدد فالمستقبل
By next summer, I will have been studying English for 3 years.
التركيب: Subject + will + have + been + V-ing
By the end of this year, I will have been living here for a decade.
Exercise: Future tenses — choose the right form.
1. I _______ (call) you later. (promise)
2. This time next week, I _______ (lie) on a beach.
3. By 2026, she _______ (graduate).
4. I _______ (finish) this project by Friday.
5. Don't call at 8; I _______ (study).
Answers: 1. will call, 2. will be lying, 3. will have graduated, 4. will have finished, 5. will be studying

1.13 Questions & Negatives (الأسئلة والنفي)

أسئلة Yes/No (واش):
Do/Does + Subject + V1? — Do you like coffee?
Did + Subject + V1? — Did she go?
Is/Are/Am + Subject + V-ing? — Are you coming?
Have/Has + Subject + V3? — Have you seen him?
Will + Subject + V1? — Will they help?
Wh- Questions (كيفاش/فين/شنو...):
Wh-word + auxiliary + Subject + main verb
Where do you live? (فين ساكن؟)
What are you doing? (شنو كتدير؟)
Why did he leave? (علاش مشى؟)
When will she come? (إيمتا غادي تجي؟)
النفي فجميع الأزمنة:
Present Simple: do/does + not — I don't know.
Past Simple: did + not — She didn't go.
Present Continuous: am/is/are + not — He isn't sleeping.
Present Perfect: have/has + not — They haven't arrived.
Future: will + not (won't) — I won't forget.

1.14 Past Participle (التصريف الثالث)

القاعدة (Regular): V1 + ed = V3
play → played → played
work → worked → worked
لاحظ: كاين أفعال شاذة (Irregular) ما تابعش هاد القاعدة
الأفعال الشاذة (Irregular): لازم تحفظهم
go → went → gone (مشى)
eat → ate → eaten (كلا)
write → wrote → written (كتب)
see → saw → seen (شاف)
speak → spoke → spoken (تهدر)
take → took → taken (خدا)
give → gave → given (عطى)
break → broke → broken (كسر)
للحصول على القائمة الكاملة، استعمل Irregular Verbs Trainer فالابليكاسيون

1.15 Gerund & Infinitive (المصدر و الفعل المجرد)

Gerund (V-ing): كيخدم كاسم
I enjoy reading. — أنا كنمتع بالقراية
Swimming is good for health. — النومان مزيان للصحة
الأفعال اللي تيجي بعدهم Gerund:
enjoy, avoid, suggest, recommend, finish, practice, mind, consider, postpone, admit, deny, imagine, miss, risk
She avoided going there. / He suggested waiting.
Infinitive (to + V1):
I want to go. — أنا بغيت نمشي
She hopes to pass. — هي كاتمنى تجح
الأفعال اللي تيجي بعدهم Infinitive:
want, need, hope, plan, decide, promise, agree, refuse, expect, learn, offer, seem, appear, fail, manage
He promised to help. / They decided to leave.
أفعال كيقبلو الاتنين (بمعنى مختلف):
stop + gerund = كمل (I stopped smoking. — كملت التدخين)
stop + infinitive = وقف باش (I stopped to smoke. — وقفت باش دخن)
remember + gerund = تذكر الحاجة اللي تما (I remember meeting him.)
remember + infinitive = تذكر باش دير (Remember to call me.)
try + gerund = جرب (Try using this method.)
try + infinitive = حاول (I tried to open the door.)

1.16 Modals (الأفعال الناقصة)

can = يقدر — I can swim. (أنا نقدر نعوم)
could = قدر فالماضي / طلب مهذب — I could run fast. / Could you help?
may = يمكن / الإذن — May I come in? / It may rain.
might = ربما (أقل يقين) — She might be late.
must = لازم / واجب — You must study. / He must be home.
have to = مضطر (خارجي) — I have to wake up early.
should = نصيحة — You should see a doctor.
ought to = نصيحة رسمية — You ought to apologize.
will = المستقبل / الوعد — I will call you.
would = طلب مهذب / عادة فالماضي — Would you open the door?
النفي:
can't = مايقدرش
mustn't = ممنوع
shouldn't = ماينبغيش
don't have to = ماشي ضروري
Exercise: Choose the correct modal.
1. You _______ (must / can / should) respect your parents — it's a duty.
2. _______ (Can / May / Must) I borrow your pen?
3. She is very talented; she _______ (can / must / should) sing beautifully.
4. You look sick. You _______ (must / should / can) see a doctor.
5. You _______ (mustn't / don't have to) wear a uniform — it's optional.
Answers: 1. must, 2. May, 3. can, 4. should, 5. don't have to

1.17 Modals Perfect (الأفعال الناقصة التامة)

Must have + V3 = حتماً — He must have forgotten. (حتماً نسي)
Might/May have + V3 = ربما — She might have left. (ربما مشات)
Could have + V3 = كان يمكن — I could have helped. (كان يمكن نعاون)
Should have + V3 = كان يجب — You should have studied. (كان يجب تقرا)
Would have + V3 = كنت غادي — I would have come. (كنت غادي نجي)
Can't have + V3 = مايمكنش — He can't have done it. (مايمكنش دارها)

1.18 Passive Voice (المبني للمجهول)

الفكرة: فال passive، الفاعل مهمش، المهم هو الفعل و object
التركيب: Object + be (حسب الزمن) + V3 + (by + agent)
معلوم (Active): The students wrote the essays.
مجهول (Passive): The essays were written by the students.

Active: The government will build a school.
Passive: A school will be built by the government.
تحويل الأزمنة لل Passive:
Present Simple: is/am/are + V3
Past Simple: was/were + V3
Future Simple: will be + V3
Present Perfect: have/has been + V3
Past Perfect: had been + V3
Modals: can be / must be / should be + V3
نصيحة للباك: ال passive كيعطي انطباع رسمي فالكتابة. استعملو فالرسائل الرسمية والمقالات.

1.19 Reported Speech (الكلام المنقول)

الفكرة: كتعود تقول شي حاجة قالها واحد بطريقة غير مباشرة
Direct: "I am happy," she said.
Reported: She said that she was happy.
تغيير الأزمنة (Backshift):
Present Simple → Past Simple — "I live here" → She said she lived there
Present Continuous → Past Continuous — "I am studying" → He said he was studying
Present Perfect → Past Perfect — "I have seen it" → He said he had seen it
Past Simple → Past Perfect — "I went" → He said he had gone
will → would — "I will come" → He said he would come
can → could — "I can swim" → He said he could swim
must → had to — "I must go" → He said he had to go
تغيير كلمات الزمان والمكان:
now → then
today → that day
yesterday → the day before
tomorrow → the next day
here → there
this → that
الأسئلة:
"Do you like coffee?" → He asked if I liked coffee.
"Where do you live?" → She asked where I lived.

الأوامر:
"Sit down!" → He told me to sit down.
"Don't go!" → She told me not to go.

1.20 Conditionals (الجمل الشرطية)

Type 0 — حقيقة عامة:
If + Present Simple, Present Simple
If you heat water to 100°C, it boils. (إلا سخنتي الما، كيغلي)
Type 1 — محتمل فالمستقبل:
If + Present Simple, will + V1
If it rains, I will stay home. (إلا شتات، غانبقى فالدار)
If you study, you will pass. (إلا قرايتي، غادي تنجح)
Type 2 — تخيلي / غير محتمل فالحاضر:
If + Past Simple, would + V1
If I had a million dollars, I would travel. (إلا كان عندي مليون دولار، غانسناف)
If I were you, I would apologize. (إلا كنت مكانك، غادي نعتذر)
Type 3 — ندم على الماضي (مستحيل):
If + Past Perfect, would have + V3
If I had studied, I would have passed. (إلا كنت قرايت، كنت غانجح — ولكن ماقرايتهاش)
Mixed Conditional: Past condition + Present result
If + Past Perfect, would + V1
If I had taken that job, I would be rich now.
ملاحظة مهمة: فالجملة الشرطية، "will" و "would" ما كيجوش ف "if clause"!
Exercise: Complete the conditionals.
1. If it rains, I _______ (stay) home. (Type 1)
2. If I _______ (have) more time, I would travel. (Type 2)
3. If she had studied, she _______ (pass). (Type 3)
4. Water _______ (boil) if you heat it to 100°C. (Type 0)
5. If I were you, I _______ (apologize). (Type 2)
Answers: 1. will stay, 2. had, 3. would have passed, 4. boils, 5. would apologize

1.21 Wish (التعبير عن التمني/الندم)

I wish + Past Simple = تمني شيء فالحاضر (عكس الواقع)
I wish I had a car. (تمنيت يكون عندي طوموبيل — ولكن ماعنديش)
I wish I were taller. (تمنيت نكون طويل — ولكن أنا قصير)
I wish + Past Perfect = ندم على الماضي
I wish I had studied harder. (تمنيت قرايت مزيان — ولكن ماقرايتهاش)
She wishes she had come. (كاتمنى أنها جات — ولكن ماجاتش)
I wish + would + V1 = تمني تغيير فالمستقبل (غالباً ديال الإزعاج)
I wish you would stop smoking. (تمنيت توقف التدخين)
I wish it would stop raining. (تمنيت الشتا توقف)

1.22 Relative Pronouns (الضمائر الموصولة)

who = اللي (للناس)
The student who won the prize is my friend. (الطالب اللي ربح الجائزة هو صاحبي)
which = اللي (للحوايج والحيوانات)
The book which I bought is interesting. (الكتاب اللي شريت مثير)
that = اللي (للناس والحوايج — فالجمل المحددة)
The car that I bought is red. (الطوموبيل اللي شريت حمرة)
whose = اللي تاعو / ديالو (للملكية)
The student whose father is a doctor works hard. (الطالب اللي باه طبيب كيقرا بزاف)
where = فين (للمكان)
The city where I was born is Fes. (المدينة فين تزاديت هي فاس)
when = اللي فات / إيمتا (للوقت)
The day when we met was special. (النهار اللي تقابلنا فيه كان خاص)
Defining (محددة) — بلا commas: معلومات ضرورية باش نعرفو على شنو كيندرو
The student who sits next to me is Ahmed.

Non-defining (غير محددة) — ب commas: معلومات إضافية
My brother, who lives in Rabat, is a doctor.

1.23 Phrasal Verbs (الأفعال المركبة)

الفكرة: فعل + حرف جر/ظرف كيعطيو معنى جديد
give up = يستسلم / يتوقف
look after = يعتني
look for = يبحث عن
put off = يؤجل
turn down = يرفض
bring up = يربي / يطرح موضوع
come across = يصادف
get along with = ينسجم مع
go through = يمر ب
run out of = ينفد منه
set up = ينشئ
carry out = ينفذ
break down = يتعطل / ينهار
take after = يشبه
call off = يلغي
Separable (قابل للفصل): I turned the offer down. / I turned down the offer.
Inseparable (ماينفصلش): I look after my sister. (مايمكنش: I look my sister after)

1.24 Linking Words (كلمات الربط)

الإضافة (Addition):
and, also, moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides, not only...but also
He is intelligent. Moreover, he is hardworking.
التضاد (Contrast):
but, however, although, even though, whereas, while, on the other hand, nevertheless, yet, in contrast
She is rich. However, she is not happy.
السبب والنتيجة (Cause & Effect):
because, since, as, because of, due to, therefore, consequently, as a result, thus, so
He studied hard, therefore, he passed.
التسلسل (Sequence):
first, firstly, first of all, second, third, next, then, after that, finally, eventually, lastly
التوضيح (Illustration):
for example, for instance, such as, like, in other words, that is to say
الخاتمة (Conclusion):
in conclusion, to sum up, in summary, overall, all in all, in a nutshell

3. Functions (الوظائف اللغوية)

1. Expressing Opinion (إبداء الرأي)

1. Expressing Opinion (إبداء الرأي)
In my opinion... — في رأيي
I believe that... — أنا كنعتقد أن
From my perspective... — من وجهة نظري
As far as I'm concerned... — بالنسبة ليا
It seems to me that... — يبان ليا أن
Personally, I think... — شخصياً كنضن
Dialogue:
Ahmed: What do you think about online learning?
Fatima: In my opinion, it's very convenient, but it requires discipline.
Ahmed: I believe that it's not as effective as face-to-face classes.
Fatima: Personally, I think both have advantages.

2. Expressing Lack of Understanding & Asking for Clarification (عدم الفهم وطلب التوضيح)

2. Expressing Lack of Understanding & Asking for Clarification (عدم الفهم وطلب التوضيح)
I don't understand... — ما فهمتش
What do you mean by...? — شنو كتعني ب
Could you explain...? — تقدر تشرح
I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. — سمحلي، ما فهمتش
Could you repeat that? — تقدر تعاود
Dialogue:
Student: Could you explain this grammar rule again?
Teacher: Of course. What don't you understand exactly?
Student: I don't understand when to use Present Perfect.
Teacher: Let me explain: we use it for experiences and past actions with present results.

3. Expressing Purpose (التعبير عن الهدف)

3. Expressing Purpose (التعبير عن الهدف)
to + infinitive — My goal is to pass the BAC. (هدفي هو نجح الباك)
in order to / so as to — I study hard in order to succeed.
for + noun/gerund — This is used for cutting.
so that + clause — I save money so that I can travel.
Dialogue:
Amina: Why are you studying so hard?
Karim: I'm studying hard in order to get a good grade.
Amina: I wake up early so that I can review before school.
Karim: Same here. My goal is to pass the BAC with honors.

4. Expressing Cause & Effect (السبب والنتيجة)

4. Expressing Cause & Effect (السبب والنتيجة)
because / since / as — I was late because I missed the bus.
because of / due to — The flight was cancelled due to bad weather.
therefore / consequently / as a result — He studied hard, therefore he passed.
so — It was raining, so I stayed home.
Dialogue:
Samir: Why were you absent yesterday?
Nadia: I missed the bus, so I was late.
Samir: And why did you miss it?
Nadia: I woke up late because I stayed up studying.
Samir: Because of that, you missed the math test too!

5. Expressing Addition & Concession (الإضافة والامتياز)

5. Expressing Addition & Concession (الإضافة والامتياز)
Addition: moreover, furthermore, in addition, besides, also
Concession: although, even though, despite, in spite of, however, nevertheless
Although it was raining, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
Dialogue:
Youssef: The exam was difficult. However, I think I did well.
Leila: I agree. Moreover, the teacher was fair.
Youssef: Although I was nervous, I managed to finish on time.
Leila: Besides being hard, it was also very long!

6. Defining, Complaining, Apologising (التعريف، الشكوى، الاعتذار)

6. Defining, Complaining, Apologising (التعريف، الشكوى، الاعتذار)
Defining: X is a type of... / X refers to... / X is used for...
Complaining: I'm not satisfied with... / I'd like to complain about... / This is unacceptable...
Apologising: I'm sorry for... / I apologize for... / Please forgive me... / I didn't mean to...
Dialogue:
Customer: I'd like to complain about the service I received.
Manager: I apologize for the inconvenience. What happened?
Customer: I waited for an hour. This is unacceptable.
Manager: I'm very sorry. Let me make it up to you.

7. Asking for and Giving Advice (طلب وتقديم النصيحة)

7. Asking for and Giving Advice (طلب وتقديم النصيحة)
Asking: What should I do? / Can you give me some advice? / What would you do?
Giving: You should... / You ought to... / If I were you, I would... / I recommend that... / Why don't you...?
Dialogue:
Student: I'm stressed about the BAC exam. What should I do?
Friend: You should make a study schedule and stick to it.
Student: What would you do if you were me?
Friend: If I were you, I would focus on past exams and practice writing.

8. Expressing Good News & Bad News (الأخبار الجيدة والسيئة)

8. Expressing Good News & Bad News (الأخبار الجيدة والسيئة)
Good news: I'm delighted to inform you... / Great news! / I'm happy to tell you...
Bad news: I'm sorry to inform you... / Unfortunately... / I'm afraid I have bad news...
Dialogue:
Samir: I'm happy to tell you that I passed the exam!
Fatima: Great news! I knew you could do it!
Samir: Thanks! Unfortunately, my friend didn't make it.
Fatima: I'm sorry to hear that. Tell him not to give up.

9. Expressing Certainty & Uncertainty (اليقين والشك)

9. Expressing Certainty & Uncertainty (اليقين والشك)
Certainty: I'm sure... / I'm certain... / Definitely... / Without doubt...
Uncertainty: I'm not sure... / It's uncertain... / Maybe... / Perhaps... / I doubt that...
Dialogue:
Amal: Are you going to pass the BAC?
Rachid: I'm sure I will. I studied very hard.
Amal: I'm not sure about myself. The math exam was tough.
Rachid: Definitely don't worry. You're a good student.
Amal: Perhaps you're right. We'll see.

10. Expressing Regret (التعبير عن الندم)

10. Expressing Regret (التعبير عن الندم)
I wish I had... — تمنيت كنت
If only I had... — إلا كنت
I regret... — نادم على
I should have... — كان يجب
I wish I had studied harder. / If only I had listened to my parents.
Dialogue:
Hassan: I failed the BAC. I wish I had studied more seriously.
Yassine: If only I had taken extra classes like you suggested.
Hassan: I should have started revising earlier.
Yassine: I regret wasting so much time on social media. Next year, we'll do better.

4. Writing (الكتابة)

Descriptive Paragraph (فقرة وصفية)

Descriptive Paragraph (فقرة وصفية)
كيوصف شي شخص، بلاصة، ولا حاجة
Structure:
- Topic sentence (جملة عامة)
- Descriptive details (appearance, location, characteristics)
- Closing sentence
Sample:
My hometown is a beautiful coastal city in northern Morocco. It has golden beaches, narrow medina streets, and friendly people. The old city walls tell stories of the past, while the modern cafés along the corniche are always full of life. In the morning, you can hear the sound of waves mixing with the call to prayer. I love my hometown because it perfectly blends tradition and modernity.

Funny Story (قصة مضحكة)

Funny Story (قصة مضحكة)
- Setting: when/where
- Characters: who
- Problem: what happened
- Climax: the funny moment
- Resolution: how it ended
Sample:
Last Eid, my little brother decided to help my mother clean the house. He picked up the vacuum cleaner with confidence, but he accidentally pointed it at the table full of sweets. Within seconds, all the candies were sucked into the machine! My mother stared at him in shock, while my brother just said, "Well, now they're clean enough to eat!" We couldn't stop laughing for the rest of the day.

Report (تقرير)

Report (تقرير)
1. Title
2. Introduction: purpose of the report
3. Findings (organized in sections)
4. Analysis / interpretation
5. Recommendations
6. Conclusion
Sample Extract:
Title: Report on Students' Study Habits
Introduction: The purpose of this report is to examine the study habits of BAC students at XYZ High School.
Findings: Most students study 2-3 hours daily. The majority prefer studying alone rather than in groups. However, 60% reported that they procrastinate using social media.
Recommendations: It is recommended that students create a fixed study schedule and limit phone usage during study time.

Formal Letter (رسالة رسمية)

Formal Letter (رسالة رسمية)
[Your Address]
[Date]
[Recipient's Name/Position]
[Company/Organization]
[Address]

Dear [Sir/Madam / Mr./Ms.],

Subject: [Topic]

I am writing to [express my concern about / apply for / complain about / request information regarding]...

[Body paragraphs with details]

I would appreciate it if you could [take action / provide information].

Yours faithfully,
[Your Full Name]
Sample:
123 Avenue Mohammed V
Casablanca, Morocco
May 15, 2026

The Principal
XYZ High School
Casablanca

Dear Sir/Madam,

Subject: Request for Permission to Organize a Study Group

I am writing to request permission to organize an English study group for BAC students. The group will meet every Saturday from 10 AM to 12 PM in the school library. We aim to help struggling students improve their grammar and writing skills.

I would appreciate it if you could consider this request.

Thank you for your time.

Yours faithfully,
Ahmed Benali

Book Review (مراجعة كتاب)

Book Review (مراجعة كتاب)
1. Basic info: title, author, genre
2. Brief summary (no spoilers)
3. Strengths: writing style, characters, themes
4. Weaknesses: what could be better
5. Recommendation: who would enjoy it
6. Rating
Sample Extract:
"The Alchemist" by Paulo Coelho is a philosophical novel about following your dreams. The story follows Santiago, a shepherd boy, on his journey to find treasure at the Egyptian pyramids. The writing is simple yet profound, and the themes of destiny and personal growth are inspiring. The book can be repetitive at times, but its message is beautiful. I recommend it to anyone who feels lost and needs motivation. Rating: 9/10.

Letter to a Pen-pal (رسالة لصديق بالمراسلة)

Letter to a Pen-pal (رسالة لصديق بالمراسلة)
Dear [Name],
How are you? I hope this letter finds you well. I'm writing to tell you about...
[Share news, experiences, interests]
[Ask questions about their life]
I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
Take care,
[Your Name]
Sample:
Dear Sarah,
How are you? I hope this letter finds you well. I'm writing to tell you about my city, Fes. It's one of the oldest cities in Morocco, famous for its ancient university and beautiful medina. I love walking through the narrow streets and smelling the spices in the souk. What is your hometown like? I would love to visit Canada one day! Please write back and tell me about your life.
Take care,
Mohamed

Application Form (استمارة التقديم)

Application Form (استمارة التقديم)
Includes: personal information, education, work experience, skills, references
معلومات شخصية، التعليم، الخبرة، المهارات، المراجع

Email (البريد الإلكتروني)

Email (البريد الإلكتروني)
To: [email]
Subject: [topic]

Dear [Name],
[Message body - clear and concise]
[Call to action or closing]
Best regards,
[Your Name]

Expository Essay (مقال تفسيري)

Expository Essay (مقال تفسيري)
Introduction: hook + thesis
Body paragraphs: each explains one aspect
Conclusion: summary + final thought
Sample (On the importance of education):
Education is the most powerful tool for building a better future. Firstly, it provides knowledge and skills that help individuals find good jobs and improve their lives. In Morocco, educated people have more opportunities to work in modern sectors like technology and business. Secondly, education promotes critical thinking and helps people make informed decisions. Finally, an educated society leads to national development and progress. In conclusion, investing in education is investing in the future of our country.

Argumentative / Persuasive Essay (مقال جدلي)

Argumentative / Persuasive Essay (مقال جدلي)
Introduction: hook + background + thesis (your position)
Body 1: your strongest argument with evidence
Body 2: your second argument
Body 3: counter-argument + rebuttal
Conclusion: restate position + recommendation
Sample (Should social media be banned for teenagers?):
Social media has become an essential part of teenagers' lives, but is it beneficial or harmful? While some argue that it helps young people stay connected, I believe that social media should be limited for teenagers. Firstly, it causes addiction and distraction from studies. Research shows that teenagers spend an average of 3 hours daily on social platforms, which affects their academic performance. Secondly, it leads to mental health issues like anxiety and low self-esteem due to constant comparison. Some may argue that social media helps develop digital skills, but this benefit does not outweigh the psychological harm. In conclusion, parents should set clear boundaries on social media use to protect their children's well-being.

5. Comprehension (الفهم)

Strategies (استراتيجيات)

استراتيجيات فهم النص فالباك:
1. اقرأ الأسئلة أولاً باش تعرف شنو كتقلب عليه
2. اقرأ النص بسرعة (skimming) باش تفهم الفكرة العامة
3. اقرأ النص بالتفصيل (scanning) باش تلاقي الأجوبة
4. حدد الكلمات المفتاحية
5. ارجع للأسئلة وأجب عليها

Question Types (أنواع الأسئلة)

أنواع الأسئلة فالباك:
Comprehension questions:
- True / False + Justification — True ولا False علا حساب النص
- Answer the questions — جاوب على الأسئلة من النص
- Find in the text words that mean — لقى فالنص كلمات كتعني
- What do the underlined words refer to? — شنو كيرجعو ليها الكلمات

Text Organization (تنظيم النص)

Text organization:
- Choose the right title
- Put the paragraphs in order
- Identify the type of text

Personal Response (الرد الشخصي)

Personal response:
- Do you agree or disagree...?
- What do you think about...?
- Give your opinion on...

Sample Practice Text (نص تطبيقي)

Read the text and answer the questions below:
Education is the foundation of any developed society. In Morocco, the government has made significant efforts to improve the education system over the past decades. However, challenges remain. Many rural areas still lack access to quality schools and qualified teachers. Dropout rates are high, especially among girls in remote villages. To address these issues, the government has launched programs to build more schools, train teachers, and provide financial support to poor families. Non-governmental organizations have also played a key role by building libraries and offering tutoring programs. Despite these efforts, more work needs to be done to ensure that every Moroccan child has access to quality education.
Questions:
1. What is the main idea of the text?
2. True or False: All rural areas in Morocco have good schools. Justify.
3. Find in the text a word that means "difficulties".
4. What do the underlined words refer to? "these issues" (line 5)
5. According to the text, what role have NGOs played?
6. Do you agree that education is important for development? Why or why not?
Answers: 1. The challenges and efforts in Moroccan education. 2. False — "Many rural areas still lack access to quality schools." 3. challenges. 4. The problems of poor schools and high dropout rates. 5. Building libraries and offering tutoring programs. 6. (open answer)

6. National Exam Questions (أسئلة الامتحان الوطني)

Grammar Exercises (تمارين القواعد)

Grammar Exercises — Typical BAC Questions:
Exercise 1: Put the verbs in brackets in the correct tense.
1. If I (have) _______ money, I would travel.
2. She (visit) _______ Paris last year.
3. They (study) _______ for the exam since morning.
4. By next year, I (graduate) _______ from university.
5. The letter (send) _______ yesterday.
Answers: 1. had, 2. visited, 3. have been studying, 4. will have graduated, 5. was sent

Rewrite Exercises (تمارين إعادة الصياغة)

Exercise 2: Rewrite the sentences using the words in brackets.
1. "I am happy," she said. (said) → __________________
2. I didn't study, so I failed. (if) → __________________
3. They built this school in 2010. (was) → __________________
4. "Do you like coffee?" he asked. (if) → __________________
Answers: 1. She said that she was happy. 2. If I had studied, I wouldn't have failed. 3. This school was built in 2010. 4. He asked if I liked coffee.

Linking Words Practice (تمارين كلمات الربط)

Exercise 3: Fill in the blanks with the correct linking word.
(moreover, however, therefore, although, because)
1. He studied hard. ______, he passed the exam.
2. She is rich. ______, she is not happy.
3. I was late ______ I missed the bus.
4. ______ it was raining, we went out.
Answers: 1. Therefore, 2. However, 3. because, 4. Although

Modals Practice (تمارين الأفعال الناقصة)

Exercise 4: Choose the correct option.
1. She (can / must / should) swim since she was five.
2. You (must / can / may) wear a helmet — it's the law.
3. (Can / May / Must) I come in?
Answers: 1. can, 2. must, 3. May

Passive Voice Practice (تمارين المبني للمجهول)

Exercise 5: Rewrite in the passive voice.
1. The students wrote the essays. → The essays _______ by the students.
2. The government will build a hospital. → A hospital _______ by the government.
3. Someone has stolen my phone. → My phone _______ stolen.
4. They clean the mosque every day. → The mosque _______ every day.
Answers: 1. were written, 2. will be built, 3. has been, 4. is cleaned

Reported Speech Practice (تمارين الكلام المنقول)

Exercise 6: Change to reported speech.
1. "I am happy," she said. → She said that _______ happy.
2. "I will come tomorrow," he said. → He said that he _______ the next day.
3. "Do you like coffee?" he asked. → He asked _______ I liked coffee.
4. "Sit down!" the teacher said. → The teacher told me _______ down.
Answers: 1. she was, 2. would come, 3. if, 4. to sit

Conditionals Practice (تمارين الشرط)

Exercise 7: Complete the conditional sentences.
1. If you heat ice, it _______ (melt).
2. If I were rich, I _______ (travel) around the world.
3. If she had studied, she _______ (pass) the exam.
4. If it rains tomorrow, we _______ (stay) home.
5. If I _______ (be) you, I would apologize.
Answers: 1. melts, 2. would travel, 3. would have passed, 4. will stay, 5. were

Proverbs (أمثال إنجليزية)

7. All that glitters is not gold. — ليس كل ما يلمع ذهباً
8. Honesty is the best policy. — الصدق أفضل سياسة
9. No pain, no gain. — لا ألم لا ربح
10. Time is gold. — الوقت من ذهب
11. Rome wasn't built in a day. — روما ما تبناتش فنهار

13. The early bird catches the worm. — الطير المبكر كيصيد الدودة
14. Two heads are better than one. — راسين أحسن من راس واحد
15. Don't put all your eggs in one basket. — لا تضع كل البيضات فسلة واحدة

Slang & Informal English (اللغة الدارجة فالإنجليزية)

Slang & Informal English (اللغة الدارجة فالإنجليزية)
gonna = going to — I'm gonna go. (غادي نمشي)
wanna = want to — I wanna eat. (بغيت ناكل)
gotta = got to — I gotta leave. (لازم نمشي)
kinda = kind of — It's kinda cool.
'cause / cuz = because — I'm late cuz I missed the bus.
ain't = am not / is not / are not / have not — I ain't going.
gimme = give me — Gimme that.
lemme = let me — Lemme see.
outta = out of — Get outta here!
y'all = you all — Y'all are awesome!

Understanding Movies & Songs (فهم الأفلام والأغاني)

Understanding Movies & Songs (فهم الأفلام والأغاني)
نصائح باش تفهم الأفلام والأغاني بالنجليزية:
1. شوف الأفلام مع subtitles فالبداية
2. حاول تسمع الأغاني وتقرا كلماتها (lyrics)
3. كرر الجمل اللي كتسمعها بصوت عالي
4. ركز على النطق (pronunciation)
5. حاول تفرق بين اللهجات (British vs American)
6. اتعلم ال slang لي كيستعملو

Frequently Asked Questions (أسئلة متكررة)

Frequently Asked Questions (أسئلة متكررة)
Q: How can I improve my English quickly?
A: Read daily, watch movies with subtitles, practice speaking with friends, and use this app!

Q: How can I pass the BAC English exam?
A: Master the grammar rules, build your vocabulary, practice writing essays, and solve past exams.

Q: What are the most common grammar mistakes in BAC?
A: Confusing tenses, subject-verb agreement, incorrect use of conditionals, and wrong word order.

Q: How many words should I write in a BAC essay?
A: Typically between 150 and 250 words, depending on the task.
